title: Salt and Smoke
summary: Raiders in gold masks burn Halcyon Cove; Kleo is taken; Argos dies giving you the boat-scroll and father's gaff clue.

title: Under the Cliffs
summary: Enter Gull Cave (D0); find father's Gaff and Prometheus Torch; beat the Stone-Back Crab.

title: The Peddler's Road
summary: Meet Mercator (Hermes) who points you to Pythona; tutorial on shops and save points.

title: The Pythia's Words
summary: Receive the prophecy of the Three Labors. Chrysor edits one line (a lie revealed later).

title: Labor I: The Hydra
summary: Clear Lerna Marsh Sanctum (D1); burn the hydra's stumps.
reward: Brand of Iolaus, Seal I, Heart Vessel

title: Labor II: The Lion
summary: Clear Nemean Cave (D2); wrestle the lion.

title: Labor III: The Hind
summary: Clear Artemis Wood Shrine (D3); chase the golden-horned hind.

title: The Harpe
summary: With three seals, Perseus' ghost gives you the Harpe in the Pythona temple.

title: A Boat Named Kymothoe
summary: Repair your father's boat: collect timber, pitch, sail cloth.

title: Smoke Over Aventina
summary: The Sibyl warns that Aventina will fall; travel there; Hermes gives Sandals.

title: The Senate Palace
summary: Infiltrate the palace (dC); defeat Gold Legate; duel Aurelia.

title: The Gilding of Aventina
summary: Midas' Hand gilds the city; the Order opens Aurea. The truth about Kleo begins.

title: Forge of Hephaestus
summary: Sail to Lemnos; beat Talos; forge the Iron Ring and Hammer; temper the Harpe.

title: Into the Gilded World
summary: Cross into Aurea with the Mirror and Iron Ring. Free the first Gilded Souls.

title: Labor IV: The Boar
summary: Clear Frostpeak Den (D4).
reward: Horn of Boreas, Seal IV, Heart Vessel

title: Labor V: The Stables
summary: Clear Augean Stables (D5); redirect the river.
reward: Nereid Fins, Seal V, Heart Vessel

title: Labor VI: The Birds
summary: Clear Stymphalian Mere (D6).

title: Labor VII: The Bull
summary: Sail to Crete; clear the Labyrinth (D7).
reward: Ariadne's Thread, Seal VII, Heart Vessel

title: Labor VIII: The Mares
summary: Clear Stables of Diomedes (D8).

title: Labor IX: The Girdle
summary: Clear Themiscyra (D9); duel Hippolyta.
reward: Aegis Shield, Seal IX, Heart Vessel

title: Labor X: The Cattle
summary: Clear Erytheia Pastures (D10).

title: Heracles Freed
summary: Return to Aventina with ten seals; free Heracles from his gilding.

title: Labor XI: The Apples
summary: Clear Hesperides (D11); defeat Ladon.
reward: Golden Apple, Orichalcum Harpe, Seal XI, Heart Vessel

title: Labor XII: The Hound
summary: Descend Avernus (D12); free Cerberus.
reward: Helm of Hades, Seal XII, Heart Vessel

title: The Cloud Gate
summary: Twelve seals open the way to Olympos' Tartarus Spire.

title: Midas' Choice
summary: Fight Midas at the Spire base; he asks to be freed.

title: Sister
summary: Duel Aurelia; the player chooses to spare or fight; she becomes Kleo again (good ending).

title: The Age That Ends
summary: Three-phase fight with Kronos-Saturn; the Ages restart.

title: Argos' Last Orders
summary: Return Argos' belongings to Halcyon after the raid; rebuild the hamlet in 5 steps.

title: Pythona's Missing Verse
summary: Find the stolen page of the prophecy in the theatre; reveals Chrysor's lie.

title: Voice of Cumae
summary: Get the Sibyl's scroll by fetching leaves from the Fog Garden.

title: The Gatekeeper's Debt
summary: Help him pay a debt so Castra Lupa opens its gates.

title: The Cursed House
summary: Bury the ghost of Agamemnon's line; lifts a curse on Mycenor.

title: Mercator's Deliveries
summary: Deliver 5 parcels across Hesperia (tutorial for fast travel).

title: Silver for the Guard
summary: Forge silver arrowheads for the Artemis Wood hunt.

title: The Cook's Secret
summary: Smuggle the cook's keys.

title: Gilded Souls
summary: Free 40 Gilded civilians across Aurea (thresholds 10/20/30/40).

title: Song of the Lost Mine
summary: Find missing miners in Argyros' Aurea.

title: The Smith's Apprentice
summary: Gather ore across Aurea for Hephaestus' new anvil.

title: The Second Prophecy
summary: Decode the true prophecy with the scroll.

title: Livia's Betrayal
summary: Learn the Consul gave Chrysor access.

title: Cassia's Fleet
summary: Rebuild 3 ships to patrol the coast.

title: Tullia's Anvil
summary: Find Order weapons stockpile.

title: The Poisoned Wheat
summary: Trace the blight of Gilded wheat to the Order's silo.

title: The Gorgo Gambit
summary: Gorgo defects; steals Order ledgers.

title: Lykon's Last Crossing
summary: Ferry souls across Avernus.

title: The Stolen Goat
summary: Chase a runaway goat across terraces.

title: Twin Brothers' Well
summary: Settle a quarrel by finding the true well owner.

title: Ghost of Little Rhea
summary: Find a toy boat across three ruins.

title: Dance of the Anklet
summary: Find a lost anklet in the Sunburnt Hills.

title: Potter's Clay
summary: Gather three colors of clay.

title: Runner Ladas
summary: Win a foot race (dash gate).

title: Wolf Pups
summary: Find 3 lost pups in the wood.

title: The Hermit's Riddle
summary: Answer 3 riddles.

title: Pan's Pipes

title: Circe's Swine
summary: Turn villagers back from pigs.

title: Calypso's Wish

title: Triton's Pearl

title: Phineus and the Harpies
summary: Drive away the harpies.

title: Constellations
summary: Map 4 constellations at 4 shrines.

title: Nereus' Riddle
summary: Catch the shape-shifter.

title: Keeper's Lights
summary: Relight 3 beacons.

title: Castor and Pollux
summary: Beat both in boxing.

title: The Sphinx's Riddle
summary: Three riddles; treasure.

title: The Pirate Queen
summary: Win a boat race.

title: Helios' Cattle
summary: Count the cattle without eating them.

title: Atlas Rests
summary: Help Atlas set the sky down (puzzle).

title: Prometheus' Letter
summary: Deliver a letter to Hephaestus.

title: Siren Song
summary: Match the song.

title: Polyphemus' Flock
summary: Return the sheep (or steal them).

title: The Peddler's Wares
summary: Buy 3 rare items to unlock.

title: Mapmaker's Sea
summary: Chart all 9 islands.

title: The Gravedigger's Jest
summary: Dig up 5 graves in order.

title: Nurse Hygeia's Cure
summary: Gather 3 herbs.

title: The Broken Statue
summary: Restore a statue's pieces.

title: Mermaids of Tritonis
summary: Dive Lake Tritonis for 3 lost lyres (needs Fins).

title: Pearl Divers
summary: Collect 5 pearls in the Salt Lagoon.

title: The Albanus Ferry
summary: Run a ferry across Lake Albanus; avoid eels.

title: The Drowned Temple
summary: Open the Sunken Temple (dW); defeat the Triton Warden.

title: Persephone's Garden
summary: Plant 5 flowers in Asphodel.

title: Fishing Derby at Lake Albanus
summary: Biggest fish in 3 minutes; needs Fisher's Line.

title: Fishing at Halcyon
summary: Catch fish for obols and hearts.

summary: Gamble with limits.

summary: Timing challenge.

summary: Hit moving targets.

summary: Pick the shell.

summary: Dig for treasure with spade.

title: Arena Rush
summary: Survive waves.

title: Harp Duel
summary: Rhythm.

title: Boat Race
summary: Race around buoys.

title: Pegasus Chase
summary: Catch a wild horse.

summary: Collect 24 laurel leaves (4 per heart = 6 hearts). Each marked on the map with a laurel icon.

title: Amphorae
summary: Find 4 amphorae.

summary: Pray at 12 god shrines.

summary: Free 40 souls.

summary: Find 60+ secret grottos (caves with chests, merchants, fountains).
